title: fix(app-shell): Studio at 1024 px keeps the package name, the flow title and the tab labels readable (objectui#12611)
body:
Fixes #12611
Clause-②: no

Studio at a narrow content column (1024 px with the rail and an aside open) keeps the package name, the item title and the tab labels readable. Every new width rule keys off the element's own box (Tailwind container queries), never the viewport; objectui#11795's fold width and objectui#12453's read-only signals are unchanged.

## What changed, per target

1. **App chip.** The chip's room is now the shell header's package column (`@container`, `STUDIO_HEADER_PACKAGE_COLUMN`); the viewport-keyed `max-w-[180px] xl:max-w-[280px]` cap becomes the chip's own 280 px. Below a 300 px column the "Read-only" word folds (`hidden @min-[300px]:inline`), the lock stays, and the name truncates only after that. The chip's tooltip (the objectui#12303 Radix wrapper) holds the whole name, the read-only sentence and "Switch / create package".
2. **Item header.** The title row is the container (`STUDIO_ITEM_ROW`). The meta slot folds first (hidden below 640 px of row) and, while it shows, takes only the room left (`basis-0 grow`), so the title never shrinks for it. Then the status chip's text folds below 480 px (`sr-only`, so it stays in the accessible name); a pencil glyph stays, and the label plus its sentence are the chip's tooltip and accessible description. The title truncates last.
3. **Tab row.** Tabs are `whitespace-nowrap shrink-0`; the row is `overflow-x-auto` with no scrollbar, `data-fade` (driven by the scroll position) fades the edge with more tabs past it, and a tab that becomes active calls `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' })`.
4. **Interfaces, folded.** The "Canvas / Properties" toggle's Properties segment carries a dot while the folded aside holds an editor (`inspectorHasContent`, mirroring the editor branches of the inspector body; the dot's meaning is the tab's accessible description, its name stays "Properties"), and the folded canvas keeps a 16 px gutter (`px-4`, the toggle on the same edge). The KPI tile itself is objectui#12623's and is not edited here.

## Deviations, each with its reason

- **Meta threshold: 640 px of the title row, not "1100 px content width".** Measured on `33fbc861d`: at 1280 px the Automations content column is 740 px (row 692) and the card itself records the meta whole there, so a 1100 px rule would hide it at 1280. 640 folds it at 1024 (row 436) and keeps it at 1280.
- **The 200 px title floor and the 120 px name floor are the yield order, not a `min-width`.** A `min-width` pads a short title or name (HotCRM is 51 px) with empty space. The browser readings below show both whole at 1024 and 1280.
- **The header container is the title row, not the header.** An unnamed container query answers the nearest container, and the tab row under the title holds the Data pillar's own `@min-[1000px]` fold that measures the content column.
- **The chip's native `title` moved into its tooltip.** One tooltip, not two. Twelve tests located the chip with `getByTitle('Switch / create package')`; they now use the new `data-testid="studio-pkg-chip"`. objectui#12453's `title` on the read-only span is kept as pinned, so hovering exactly the lock also shows the browser's native hint.
- **The status chip's sentence moved from `title` to the tooltip and `aria-describedby`.** `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyWording-11781.test.tsx` now asserts it as the chip's accessible description. The chip is focusable (`tabIndex 0`) so keyboard users reach the tooltip.
- **Automations' read-only link** (in the tab row since objectui#12453) is no longer cut mid-word; on a narrow row it sits at the scroll end behind the fade, reachable by scrolling and by Tab. Moving it out of the tab row would edit the Automations region, outside this claim's surface.
- **PM mechanism assumption 4 was partly false.** The comment near objectui#11795 that it names is the Automations configuration drawer, and `if-properties-toggle` is the header icon shown only when not folded. The folded toggle is `studio-center-tabs` (ADR-0057 P3c, fold at `useIsWideViewport`), so the dot is on its Properties trigger. Assumptions 1 to 3 held.

## Browser readings (HotCRM, read-only package, Chromium, en)

Before, on `33fbc861d`, 1024 x 768: chip name 39 px of 51 ("Hot…"); "Enroll Members in Campaign" `scrollWidth` 245 against `clientWidth` 129; Access tab labels wrapped inside their 36 px tabs; Automations tab row 636 wide in a 436 row, its read-only link clipped.

After, on `dfbb125`:

| Viewport | Pillar | Chip visible text | Title `scrollWidth` / `clientWidth` | Tab row height · scroll / client · fade |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1024 light | Data | HotCRM Read-only (name 51 / 51) | Account 72 / 72 | 36 · 736 / 736 · none |
| 1024 light | Automations | HotCRM Read-only | Enroll Members in Campaign 245 / 245 | 36 · 636 / 436 · end |
| 1024 light | Access | HotCRM Read-only | Guest (Public Forms) 179 / 179 | 36 · 833 / 736 · end |
| 1024 light | Interfaces | HotCRM Read-only | Home 51 / 51 | 36 · Properties dot shown, canvas gutter 16px |
| 1024 dark | all four | same readings as 1024 light | | |
| 1280 light | Automations | HotCRM Read-only | 245 / 245, meta shown | 36 · 692 / 692 · none |
| 1280 light | Access | HotCRM Read-only | 179 / 179 | 36 · 992 / 992 · none |
| 1280 light | Interfaces | HotCRM Read-only | Home 51 / 51 | not folded, gutter 24px, no toggle |

At a 700 px window the header's package column is 252 px: the chip reads "HotCRM" with the lock, the word folded, the name 51 / 51. At 820 px (column 312) the word is back. Every tab is 36 px high in every capture. The title measurements were also checked sub-pixel (text range width equals the box width), after a first cut showed that a heavy `shrink` weight on the meta still drew a fraction-of-a-pixel ellipsis on the Access title.

Not measured in the browser: the status chip's folded text (HotCRM is read-only, so no draft chip renders); jsdom pins it.

## Screenshots

Evidence branch `claude/issue-12611-evidence` at `ab8825f6` (never merged), `docs/design/findings/12611/`:

- Data: [1024 light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-data-1024-light.png?raw=true) · [1024 dark](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-data-1024-dark.png?raw=true) · [1280 light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-data-1280-light.png?raw=true) · [chip at 700 px](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-data-chip-700-light.png?raw=true)
- Automations: [1024 light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-automations-1024-light.png?raw=true) · [1024 dark](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-automations-1024-dark.png?raw=true) · [1280 light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-automations-1280-light.png?raw=true)

- Interfaces: [1024 light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-interfaces-1024-light.png?raw=true) · [1024 dark](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-interfaces-1024-dark.png?raw=true) · [1280 light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/ab8825f63fbcf1c312c2b0659460b1d7b6ea23eb/docs/design/findings/12611/after-interfaces-1280-light.png?raw=true)

The Interfaces captures predate objectui#12623 on main, so the KPI tiles still show that card's truncation.

## Tests (all on `dfbb125`)

jsdom has no layout, so the card's three test bullets are measured in the browser (table above) and pinned as class contracts in jsdom:

- `StudioItemHeader.narrowWidth-12611.test.tsx`: the row is the container and the header is not; slot order title, identity, status, meta, actions; the meta's fold and zero-basis classes; the status chip's pencil, folding text, label-only text, accessible description and tooltip; the 26-character title with no hiding class; the tab row's one-line and scroll classes; `data-fade` from the scroll position; the active tab's `scrollIntoView`; a forwarded ref still reaches the tab.
- `StudioDesignSurface.narrowChip-12611.test.tsx`: the chip's text starts with "HotCRM"; name, then lock and word, then chevron; only the word carries the hiding class; the container column; no breakpoint variant on the chip; the tooltip content (read-only and writable).
- `InterfacesPillar.foldedToggle-12611.test.tsx`: the Properties dot appears with an editor and goes with it, the tab's name stays "Properties"; the 16 px gutter folded, 24 px beside the aside.
- Updated: `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyWording-11781.test.tsx` (accessible description), and the chip locator in twelve `StudioDesignSurface.*` tests.

Ablation: thirteen one-line mutations, each committed state restored by `git checkout HEAD`, file hash compared with the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards. Each turned its pin red: row container, meta fold, status text fold, tab nowrap, tab row scroll, fade attribute, active `scrollIntoView` (each 1 failed of 9); chip word fold, chip column container (1 of 4), chip tooltip name (2 of 4); Properties dot, folded gutter (1 of 3); status description (the 11781 pin, 1 of 4).

Gates, run locally on `dfbb125`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: exit 0, 1435 files passed and 1 skipped, 13586 tests passed and 9 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`: exit 0.
- `eslint` on the 21 touched files: exit 0, 0 errors; its 18 warnings are all on lines this diff does not touch.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`: exit 0 each (one new key, `engine.studio.inspector.propsHasContent`, en and zh). `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.

The changeset is `.changeset/12611-studio-narrow-width.md` (app-shell patch).
